page.content:
Bison's crime empire and Psycho Power cult.

How Shadaloo connects

  • Character: M. Bison — M. Bison rules Shadaloo through Psycho Power.
  • Character: Chun-Li — Chun-Li hunts Shadaloo for her father's death.
  • Topic: Street Fighter — Shadaloo is the crime empire the World Warriors keep fighting.
  • Concept: Psycho Power — Psycho Power is the energy cult at the center of Shadaloo.
  • Character: Cammy White — Cammy began as a Shadaloo Doll before joining Delta Red.
  • Character: Juri Han — Juri Han infiltrated Shadaloo to tear it apart from inside.
  • Event: World Warrior tournament — Shadaloo backed the Street Fighter II World Warrior tournament.

What is Shadaloo?

Shadaloo is M. Bison's global crime organization: Dolls, Psycho Power experiments, and the shadow government the World Warriors keep dismantling.

Key threads lead to M. Bison, Chun-Li, Street Fighter, Psycho Power, Cammy White and Juri Han.
